## Ingredients

- 1 tablespoon cooking oil
- 450 g potato about 2 medium-sized potatoes
- 3 dried chilli deseeded
- 1/2 teaspoon Sichuan peppercorns
- 2 fresh chilli sliced (optinal if you want to reduce the heat)
- 3 cloves garlic sliced
- 1 teaspoon black rice vinegar (can sub rice vinegar or balsamic if need be)
- 1/4 teaspoon salt or to taste

Or written a different way: 

- 450 g potatoes julienned and soaking in cold water 
- 1 carrot 
- 3 cloves garlic minced 
- Some ginger if desired like a tablespoon 
- 1/2 teaspoon Sichuan peppercorns
- 1 teaspoon black rice vinegar (can use a balsamic vinegar as substitute)

## Instructions

- After cutting potatoes put in cold water to remove starch. 
- Heat up oil in wok and toss Szechwan peppercorns until fragment. Remove peppercorns. 
- Alternatively could grind the peppers in advance and leave them in for a stronger taste
- Add carrots and stir around a couple seconds 
- Add potatoes and garlic and ginger. Toss immediately to coat in oil and prevent starch from forming. Stir fry constantly until the potato is cooked (should be still a bit crunchy).
- You can add a teaspoon of water to make the potatoes softer if desired. 
- Add rice vinegar and salt and a little sugar. Give everything a quick stir then dish out.
